title: The Agent Did What?
summary: An Anthropic test agent sent a made-up tip to the Philadelphia police's unsolved-murders site in July, and the police only heard why in October.
Poppy, the standard Meta and Sierra proposed for letting AI agents into your accounts, and why Amazon isn't on the list.
Which revenue is real? OpenAI's roughly $50 billion versus the $68 billion headline, and why AI stocks fell.
Two predictions on the record, so we can score them later.
